title: Said "you too" to the waiter? Nobody noticed 🔦 #shorts
description:
The waiter said "Enjoy your meal." You said "You too." Here's the part almost nobody knows: in a famous Cornell study, people in an embarrassing T-shirt guessed half the room noticed. The real number? Roughly a quarter. It's called the spotlight effect. 🔦

Watch the full video: https://youtu.be/fN20EY-EMLk

#psychology #overthinking #shorts
